The plate itself holds only crumbs, so the food on it is negligible. The tray also holds a mug of coffee with milk, an empty peanut butter packet, and an empty small container.

I estimate roughly 2 g of crumbs at about 4 kcal per gram, which is about 8 kcal. That is the figure for the plate alone.

The question asks about "everything on the plate", so I'm counting only the crumbs. The coffee is a separate item in the mug. A milk coffee is roughly 30 kcal and 200 g, but I'm leaving it out. The small amount of leftover peanut butter in the packet and container is also negligible.

{"kcal": 8, "mass_g": 2}
